title: InstructionDiff

fromVersion.description: The entry's version the copy holds.

from.description: The entry's text at fromVersion, the old side of what the catalogue changed; null when this build's catalogue does not hold that version (a copy made by a newer build).

to.description: The entry's current text: the new side of both diffs, and the body Replace sets.

body.description: The copy's body as it is now, the old side of what Replace would change. It need not equal from even when never edited: a Keep leaves the older text, and an import holds the file's.

description: What a catalogue entry changed since the version a copy holds (from against to) and what Replace would change in the copy (body against to), with both versions.
